title: Decisioning & Next-Best-Action
description: Master PEGA's decisioning engine, predictive analytics, and next-best-action strategies for personalized customer experiences

content.introduction: PEGA's decisioning engine combines predictive analytics, business rules, and real-time data to deliver personalized next-best-actions. This lesson covers the complete decisioning lifecycle from strategy design to AI optimization.

sections.title: Decisioning Architecture
sections.content: Understand the PEGA decisioning architecture including decision strategies, adaptive models, arbitration engines, and real-time processing capabilities.

sections.title: Predictive Analytics
sections.content: Leverage PEGA's built-in predictive analytics to anticipate customer needs, predict outcomes, and optimize interactions based on historical data and real-time context.

sections.title: Next-Best-Action Strategies
sections.content: Design comprehensive next-best-action strategies that consider customer context, business objectives, regulatory constraints, and channel preferences.

sections.title: Adaptive Models
sections.content: Configure adaptive models that learn from customer interactions and continuously improve decision accuracy. Understand model training, validation, and deployment.

sections.title: Arbitration and Optimization
sections.content: Implement arbitration engines that select the optimal action from multiple candidates based on business rules, customer preferences, and predicted outcomes.

sections.title: Real-Time Decision Scenarios
sections.content: Handle complex real-time scenarios where decisions must be made instantly based on current context, customer behavior, and business priorities.
